verification.notes: Reuters footage confirms Owens spoke at SPIEF, and reporting confirms Putin and Dugin participated in the same forum. records.text: Laura Loomer reported that a source alleged Candace Owens and George Farmer previously met Alexander Dugin in Italy.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: A source tells me Candace and her husband allegedly previously met with Dugin in Italy. Candace has pretended not to know Dugin.

verification.notes: Transcript context quotes the Loomer post and its anonymous-source allegation. This verifies that Loomer reported the allegation, not that the alleged Italy meeting occurred.
